maddeler.e:
استضفن (form X)
# اِسْتَضَفْنَ (istaḍafna) /is.ta.dˤaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَضَافَ (istaḍāfa)
# اُسْتُضِفْنَ (ustuḍifna) /us.tu.dˤif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَضَافَ (istaḍāfa)
# اِسْتَضِفْنَ (istaḍifna) /is.ta.dˤif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَضَافَ (istaḍāfa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
